marks.gloss_en: the emperor, seeing them wretched: these are not they
RYbC to the elders: fill it [the vessel holding the water of the House of the Swallowed] and go your way -- they filled until their shoulders gave and were swallowed
a donkey that had not given birth and bore two males: he gives one lamb to the kohen
his two donkeys that had not given birth bore two males: he gives two lambs to the kohen
one had given birth and one had not, and they bore two males: he gives one lamb to the kohen
as it is said: 'and the firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a seh' (Shemot 34:20)
דאי רבי יוסי הגלילי -- האמר אפשר לצמצם: were the mishna his, twin males could be both firstborn, not one lamb
who is the tanna? R' Yirmeya: [the mishna] is not according to R' Yosei HaGelili
שאני התם דכתיב הזכרים לה׳ -- R' Yosei HaGelili's view there rests on a verse, so it shows nothing about the donkey
Abaye: you may even say [the mishna is] R' Yosei HaGelili
וליגמר מיניה! -- let [the donkey] be learned from it
הא מיעט רחמנא ״הזכרים״ -- the Merciful One restricted [with] 'the males'
בשלמא לרבי ירמיה דלא מוקי לה כרבי יוסי הגלילי -- היינו דלא קתני ויצאו שני ראשיהן כאחד; אלא לאביי -- ליתני ויצאו שני ראשיהן כאחד!
ועוד תניא: חמורו שלא ביכרה... ויצאו שני ראשיהן כאחד, רבי יוסי הגלילי אומר שניהן לכהן, שנאמר הזכרים לה׳
his donkey that had not given birth bore two males and both heads emerged as one -- R' Yosei HaGelili: both are the kohen's
